description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes for applying patches in a version control system, including apply state management, patch representation, and diff parsing.

classes.name: apply_state
classes.description: Structure holding the current state and configuration for applying patches.

classes.name: patch
classes.description: Structure representing a patch to a file, including metadata, fragments, and related info.

methods.name: apply_parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for applying patches.

methods.name: init_apply_state
methods.description: Initializes the apply_state structure with repository info and prefix.

methods.name: clear_apply_state
methods.description: Clears and frees resources associated with apply_state.

methods.name: check_apply_state
methods.description: Checks the validity of the current apply_state.

methods.name: parse_git_diff_header
methods.description: Parses a git diff header line into a patch structure.

methods.name: release_patch
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a patch.

methods.name: apply_all_patches
methods.description: Applies all patches based on the current apply_state and options.
